name: 惊喜花园
description: 十六幅躲猫猫图画，总有小东西藏在里面：从礼盒里冒出的花、鼹鼠丘里的鼹鼠、蘑菇屋里的老鼠、野餐篮里的小狗、从蛋里孵出的小龙宝宝、草丛里的宝箱，还有更多。
style: Children's coloring book page, square 1:1. Pure white background with a wide empty white margin on all sides; nothing touches the edges. Bold uniform thick black outlines, same weight everywhere. No shading, no grey, no texture, no hatching, no black fills except tiny eye dots, no text, no border frame. Every shape fully closed. One large friendly scene, centered, alone on the page with at most a small grassy mound or ground line; no extra background plants, clouds or scenery beyond what the subject describes. About 16 large closed areas to color. Any animal is a small cute baby with a round head, small solid black dot eyes and a smile that is one short line, no teeth, no claws, no spikes. Very simple, cute, for a 3-year-old.

pages.name: 礼盒花开
pages.subject: an open gift box drawn as one simple square front with one wide ribbon band down the middle, its lid tipped back with one big bow, and one giant smiling flower with six wide round petals, a thick stem and two big leaves popping up out of the box

pages.name: 鼹鼠土丘
pages.subject: a round baby mole with a big round nose and two round paws peeking out of a big rounded dirt molehill with three big round pebbles on it, with two tall tulips with thick stems and wide leaves growing beside the molehill, on a grassy mound

pages.name: 蘑菇屋
pages.subject: one big mushroom house with a round cap with five large round spots, a round door and one round window with a little mouse peeking out of the window, standing on a small grassy mound

pages.name: 野餐小狗
pages.subject: a round picnic basket with its lid lifted, a puppy with floppy ears peeking out from under the lid, and one big apple beside the basket, on a small grassy mound

pages.name: 靴子里的小鸟
pages.subject: one big rain boot standing upright on a grassy mound, with two big flowers with five wide round petals on thick stems and two wide leaves growing out of the top, and a round bird peeking over the edge of the boot between them

pages.name: 南瓜探头
pages.subject: one big round pumpkin with a curly stem and one leaf, with a round hole in its side and a chipmunk with round cheeks peeking out of the hole

pages.name: 树桩浣熊
pages.subject: a wide tree stump with a round hole in the front and a baby raccoon with a simple outlined eye mask peeking out of the hole, one small mushroom beside the stump

pages.name: 苹果小虫
pages.subject: one giant apple with a thick stem and two big leaves, sitting on a small grassy mound with two small round flowers, with a round hole in the side and a smiling worm made of three round segments poking out of the hole

pages.name: 白菜里的小窝
pages.subject: one giant cabbage made of six big rounded leaves with a round guinea pig peeking out from between the top leaves

pages.name: 太阳帽惊喜
pages.subject: a big round straw sun hat with a wide brim and a ribbon bow lying on a grassy mound, with a round hamster peeking out from under the brim

pages.name: 水桶小猪
pages.subject: one very big plain garden bucket lying on its side filling most of the page, its big round open end facing us, with a round piglet with two big round ears, a round snout and two round front hooves peeking out of the opening, one wide band around the bucket, resting on a wide closed oval grassy mound, and one big flower with five round petals on a thick stem beside it

pages.name: 龙蛋
pages.subject: a big egg cracked open in a round nest of big leaves, with a friendly round baby dragon with two tiny rounded wings and a round tummy popping out of the top of the egg

pages.name: 云朵花
pages.subject: a wide smiling rain cloud across the top left with three large fat raindrops each as big as a plum, and a giant flower filling the right and middle of the page: one huge smiling round middle, five huge round petals each as big as the middle, a very thick stem and two huge leaves, growing out of one big wide flower pot with a wide rim, the pot sitting on a wide closed oval grassy mound

pages.name: 木头里的臭鼬
pages.subject: one very big hollow log lying on its side filling most of the page, a plain smooth tube with two big round knot holes and no wood rings or bark lines, its big round opening at the front, a baby skunk with a round head, one wide outlined stripe and two round paws peeking out of the opening, its big fluffy tail curling up over the top of the log, resting on a wide closed oval grassy mound with one big mushroom beside it

pages.name: 小棚山羊
pages.subject: a small garden shed with a pointed roof and a round window and a wide open doorway with no door, with a big baby goat with two tiny rounded horns and floppy ears peeking out of the doorway, and one big round bush beside the shed

pages.name: 宝箱
pages.subject: a big treasure chest sitting on a grassy mound, its lid wide open, with one wide band across the front and a round lock, filled with five big round jewels, and a big garden spade with a thick handle standing beside it
